---
applyTo: "src/Services/**/*.Infrastructure/**/*.cs,src/Tools/SuperApp.Cli/Templates/superapp-service/ServiceName.Infrastructure/**/*.cs"
---

# Infrastructure layer

- Write side: `{Service}WriteDbContext : WriteDbContextBase` (unit of work, domain event dispatch, outbox). EF configurations only
  in `Persistence/Write/Configurations/` as `internal sealed` `IEntityTypeConfiguration<T>`: table name, key with
  `ValueGeneratedNever()`, lengths from domain constants, `HasCheckConstraint` for domain ranges, unique indexes with explicit
  `HasDatabaseName`, `Property<byte[]>("Version").IsRowVersion()`, `Ignore(x => x.DomainEvents)`, `ComplexProperty` for
  multi-value VOs, `OwnsMany` for owned collections (`ValueGeneratedNever()` on owned keys such as positions). Strongly typed
  IDs and single-value objects need no conversion code (framework convention).
- Repositories in `Persistence/Write/Repositories/`, `internal sealed`, one per aggregate: async reads with `CancellationToken`,
  synchronous `Add`/`Remove` (`context.Add(...)`), never `SaveChanges`. Deduplicate input collections before counting.
- Unique indexes that concurrent requests can violate are mapped in `{Service}WriteDbContext.UniqueConstraintErrors` to the error
  the handler returns for the sequential duplicate.
- Read side: `{Service}ReadDbContext : ReadDbContextBase` (no tracking, no migrations). Read models are flat `internal sealed`
  classes in `Persistence/Read/Models/{Name}Row.cs` with configurations in `Persistence/Read/Configurations/`; expose
  `internal IQueryable<{Name}Row>` properties on the read context.
- Query handlers in `Features/{Aggregate}/{UseCase}Handler.cs`, `internal sealed`, `IQueryHandler<TQuery, Result<TDto>>`:
  project with `Select` to DTOs, deterministic ordering, paging with `Math.Clamp(pageSize, 1, Paging.MaxPageSize)` and
  `Paging.Skip`, visibility rules via `ICurrentUser`, NotFound errors for missing or invisible items.
- Cache only in query handlers and ACL clients through `FailSafeCache`; keys, tags and `FailSafeOptions` in `Caching/{Service}Cache.cs`
  (keys versioned `{service}:{type}:v{n}:{id}`); invalidation in `Caching/*CacheInvalidation.cs` domain event handlers through
  `IUnitOfWork.OnCommitted(...)`, never directly.
- Synchronous calls (ADR-0014, ADR-0040): Refit interfaces and DTOs generated by Refitter from the provider's committed contract
  (`.refitter` file, used operations only, `internal` types), registered with `AddDownstreamApi<T>(configuration, "{Name}")`
  (address `Downstream:{Name}:BaseAddress`, standard resilience, retries only for idempotent methods), wrapped by an ACL that maps
  foreign DTOs to this context's concepts.
  - User-context calls (our services within the experience, another experience's BFF internal API) forward the current user's token
    unchanged: `.AddUserTokenForwarding()` on the client builder. Never write a local substitute.
  - Client credentials (`Http/ClientCredentials`) only for system calls: explicitly marked operations, scope
    `{experience}.internal.system.*` (another experience's internal BFF API) or `{service}.system.{action}` (service → service within the experience, ADR-0042), caller audit, never a specific person's data selected only by a payload ID.
  - Never call another experience's domain services; external systems are called with our own credentials, never the user's token.
- Composition root `InfrastructureServiceCollectionExtensions`: register repositories and ports; Application and Infrastructure
  assemblies are scanned automatically for handlers and validators.
- `Add{Service}Core` calls `services.AddAppFeatureFlags(configuration)` (ADR-0036): it registers `IFeatureFlags` (PostHog when
  `Analytics:ProjectToken` is set, otherwise values from `FeatureFlags:{key}` with the code default as fallback) and validates the
  `Analytics` section at startup. It needs `ICurrentUser` from the host (Api: the request user; Worker: `AddAppWorker`; tests: fakes).
  Keep that single call; never register a PostHog client, call PostHog or reference the `PostHog` package from a service
  (architecture rule 11). Analytics settings and secrets come from configuration and Vault (`Analytics__*`), never `appsettings*.json`.
- Migrations: see `migrations.instructions.md`.
